construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by Gurobi (gurobi_write, MPS); read back by gurobi_read and by MOSEK (mosekopt read), both equal to the definition.
derivation: Minimise 2 x1 + 3 x2 + x3 subject to x1 + x2 + x3 = 4, x1 - x2 >= 1, x2 + x3 <= 3, 0 <= x <= 10. Eliminating x3 = 4 - x1 - x2 gives objective 4 + x1 + 2 x2 with x1 - x2 >= 1, x1 >= 1 (from x2 + x3 <= 3) and x1 + x2 <= 4 (from x3 >= 0). Since x1 >= 1 and x2 >= 0 with positive coefficients, the minimum 4 + 1 + 0 = 5 is attained only at x1 = 1, x2 = 0, hence x3 = 3.
